capabilities: Auto-detect scripture references in notes and turn them into interactive links
Preview full verse text, cross-references, footnotes, and study notes in a sidebar pane
Reformat references between Full, Standard, and Official book-name formats
Insert citations that replace a reference with the full verse text
Parse selections or documents into a searchable, sortable table of references
extras: Verse text comes from the New World Translation (© Watch Tower Bible and Tract Society); lookups require network requests and are cached for one hour. The author warns against unofficial forks, which are not reviewed or supported. Manual installation into the plugins folder is required.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to detect, link, preview, or convert Bible scripture references written in varying book-name styles and languages.

relations.evidence: Ctrl/Cmd+click opens references directly in JW Library (if installed)

summary: Scripture reference toolkit that auto-detects Bible references, previews verse text from the NWT, reformats book names, and inserts citations.
